verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data downloads are a fair question for a government company-registry service, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers the online incorporation workflow: authentication, pact signing, payment, and per-company access codes to the electronic card and permanent certificate. Nothing in the pack shows published bulk datasets, registry extracts or statistics downloads.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
